en.title: GTA 6 Launch Crashes Internet Records: Xfinity Sees Unprecedented Traffic Spike
en.summary: The highly anticipated launch of **Grand Theft Auto VI** has already shattered internet traffic records, overwhelming providers like Xfinity. Early access via a New Zealand region trick on Xbox fueled a massive surge, demonstrating the game's colossal demand.
en.body:
The wait for **Grand Theft Auto VI** is finally over, and it's already making history – not just in Vice City, but in the real world too. Internet service provider **Xfinity** has reported an unprecedented spike in network traffic, directly linked to players eager to dive into Rockstar's latest masterpiece. Around the time **GTA 6** officially became playable in New Zealand, **Xfinity** witnessed a staggering fourfold increase in traffic originating from Xbox consoles. This surge was largely thanks to a clever workaround allowing players to change their console's region to New Zealand, granting them hours of early access.

This early access window proved to be a massive boon for Xbox players and a significant driver of online buzz. While Sony secured a prominent marketing deal positioning the **PS5** as the optimal platform for **GTA 6**, the New Zealand loophole offered a unique advantage for Xbox users. The flood of early gameplay footage hitting social media platforms was immense, with major content creators leveraging the same trick. This resulted in record-breaking viewership on platforms like Twitch, where tens of millions of watch hours were accumulated within hours of the game's initial availability.

## Internet Infrastructure Under Strain
The sheer demand for **GTA 6** has tested broadband networks like never before. **Comcast**, the parent company of **Xfinity**, confirmed that the game's pre-loads set a new company record for network traffic. Elad Nafshi, **Comcast**'s Chief Network Officer, stated that this demand extends beyond initial downloads, anticipating sustained traffic from gameplay streaming and future updates. To manage this colossal event, **Xfinity** is offering eligible customers a complimentary 15-day speed boost of up to 2Gbps, a proactive measure acknowledging that **GTA 6** could be the biggest moment in internet history. Spectrum also reported a 40-50 percent rise in gaming download traffic during the pre-load period.

## A Critical and Commercial Juggernaut
Beyond the network strain, **GTA 6** is already solidifying its place as a critical darling. The game has been met with universal praise, with outlets like IGN awarding it a perfect 10 for its meticulous attention to detail and unparalleled depth. Currently, **GTA 6** is tied with **The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time** for the highest-rated game on Metacritic, a testament to its quality. While official sales figures are yet to be released, industry analysts expect them to be astronomical, potentially setting new benchmarks for entertainment launches. The anticipation for these numbers is palpable, with an announcement expected imminently.

What's Next
While the initial launch has been a phenomenal success, the coming days and weeks will reveal the full extent of **GTA 6**'s impact. Keep an eye out for official sales figures from Rockstar and ongoing discussions about its critical reception and cultural footprint.

content_raw: Internet provider Xfinity has reported a massive spike in traffic on Xbox consoles for GTA 6's New Zealand launch. Xfinity says it saw a jump in Xbox hardware traffic four times more than normal around the time GTA 6 became available in New Zealand. Although Xfinity provides its services in the United States, Xbox users were able to take advantage of a loophole that let them change their console's region to New Zealand, allowing them start playing the game early despite their actual geographic location. It's one of the only real notable advantages Xbox has had over PlayStation with this game, as Rockstar secured a marketing deal to advertise GTA 6 as playing best on PS5. However, these hours of early access have proven to be very lucrative for Xbox players. As a result, tons of footage for the game has been circulating on social media all day long. Major content creators also took advantage of the New Zealand trick, resulting in record-breaking viewership across platforms like Twitch . As of this afternoon, Twitch reported that tens of millions of watch hours had already been accumulated. Right now, we still don't know how many copies of GTA 6 have sold, but we'll likely hear something by the end of this week or very early next week, depending on how quickly Rockstar wants to boast. This is expected to be the biggest entertainment launch of all-time, after all, and the official numbers will likely be eyewatering. From a critical perspective, GTA 6 has received nothing but praise. IGN gave the game a 10 for its impeccable attention to detail and unprecedented depth, but we weren't alone in that analysis. The game is currently tied with The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for the highest rated game on Metacritic. It's also nominated for Game of the Year , in addition to seven other awards at The Game Awards.
